normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only shapes the vote() state updates and has no independent semantics
The voter parameter is only the account whose balances/delegates updateVotes mutates
The servicePool parameter merely selects the pool index used by vote()
The service parameter merely selects the service index used by vote()
The day parameter only bounds the claim window executed by serviceClaimUpTo
The delegatee parameter is consumed solely by delegate()
The currentDay local is a derived timestamp index consumed by vote() bookkeeping
The dayLastClaimedFor local is computed and used only inside the _serviceClaim reward loop
The vestingDays local is fetched and consumed only by _serviceClaim
The rewards local is the value passed directly into the sbController.requestRewards external call
